title: Steps table shows each step's Depends on and Unlocks; check:work warns on prose-only blockers
goal: Each open step's prerequisites and the steps it unlocks are visible in the generated steps table, and a blocker named only in prose is flagged
acceptance: The steps table has the step's Depends on and Unlocks (linked step IDs) for open steps; closed prerequisites are not shown
check:work warns, without failing, when a record's Next action or Check names another open record next to waiting words and no step of it is in the open step's dependsOn
Tests with invented records; the copied tool is released and reconciled in projects as usual
escalation: A change to the ledger layout every project sees is released as a minor version

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-19 from the NERV request and its one-off scan. Not a measurement.
